ui_dependency.policy: Use the reviewed shared Bevy web/native shell; do not restore deleted DOM lobby code.

scope.public_directory: Every online account, global paging/search; guests counted but not listed.
scope.direct_challenge: Recipient-bound lobby notification with explicit acceptance, private unrated Challenge pairing.
scope.rematch: Latest valid server ticket after completed online PvP; shared Result/Active players actions; no rating change.
scope.global: Single actor directly; actual bounded public-snapshot aggregation when fixed release slots are enabled.
exclusions: retroactive rematch from a history row
scope.match_history: Persistent account-bound completed online results and personal statistics; owner list/detail and permission-checked public projection.
scope.history_visibility: Account chooses public or private; private by default; enforce across all entries, legacy profile recent, caches and public-serving slots.

proposed_defaults.client_refresh_seconds: Preserve existing 5 seconds, with backoff/hidden-page pause.
proposed_defaults.status: Proposed initial limits; not measured capacity or an active configuration change.

proposed_wire.private_id: PlayerInviteId = [u8; 16], OS-random, participant-bound, not a bearer join or authentication token.
proposed_wire.version: Freeze the next genuinely unused version and append-only discriminants at execution S0; do not assume 31 is free.

acceptance_cases.name: Complete browse and search
acceptance_cases.scenario: 137 connected account fixtures span at least three pages; search finds a target outside page one; filters precede paging; changing snapshot revision resets/deduplicates pages.

acceptance_cases.name: True availability
acceptance_cases.scenario: Idle, Queued, InRoom, InChallenge, Watching, InMatch, disconnected and opted-out controllers show accurate coarse status; only eligible Idle endpoints can send/accept.

acceptance_cases.name: Consented private pairing
acceptance_cases.scenario: Sender sends, actual recipient accepts; exactly one MatchStart per peer in private Challenge mode; fresh seed and no rating change.

acceptance_cases.name: Terminal lifecycle
acceptance_cases.scenario: Decline, sender Cancel and TTL expiry notify the right peers, free bounded resources and cannot be replayed into a match.

acceptance_cases.name: Authorization and self challenge
acceptance_cases.scenario: Third party cannot answer/cancel using another ID; wrong account/controller, alternate casing, own account and P39 bearer token cannot hijack a directed invite.

acceptance_cases.name: Crossed and duplicate requests
acceptance_cases.scenario: Repeated sends, crossed A/B sends and duplicate simultaneous accept messages coalesce or terminate safely; Send never implicitly accepts and no duplicate pairing occurs.

acceptance_cases.name: Accept-time race and release gate
acceptance_cases.scenario: Target/source becomes queued, joins a room/game, opts out, expires auth, loses connection or loses admission after the snapshot; accept fails safely without evicting current activity.

acceptance_cases.name: Auth and reconnect continuity
acceptance_cases.scenario: Retained-session reconnect restores only remaining TTL/state; passive refresh does not take over; explicit takeover/logout/revocation cancel; no disconnected auto-start or TTL extension.

acceptance_cases.name: Legacy flow preservation
acceptance_cases.scenario: Existing Quick Challenge link, self/expired/single-use link rejection, private rooms, ranked/casual queues and watch flow still follow their existing contracts.

acceptance_cases.name: Latest-opponent rematch
acceptance_cases.scenario: Completed Challenge/Casual/Ranked/private PvP issues one latest ticket; both consent within existing TTL; next game is unrated private Challenge with fresh seed; Practice/spectators never get tickets.

acceptance_cases.name: Result and players navigation
acceptance_cases.scenario: Open Active players without Cancel; same-opponent private offer and requested flags remain; explicit decline/new activity close it; guest opponent card is participant-only.

acceptance_cases.name: Privacy and API/internal-route boundary
acceptance_cases.scenario: Public rows expose no keys/session IDs/invite IDs/private matches/guest enumeration; private WS state is participant-only; internal snapshot denies forwarded/public access and is proxy-blocked; names render as text.

acceptance_cases.name: Abuse and bounds
acceptance_cases.scenario: Enforce TTL, one outbox, five inbox, pair cooldown, process cap and IP/account/guest rates; invented targets, slow peers and preference floods cannot grow auxiliary maps or block the lobby.

acceptance_cases.name: Actual global snapshots
acceptance_cases.scenario: Two slot fixtures aggregate accounts and counts, deduplicate generations/controllers, discard retired snapshots and label a slow/missing/stale slot as incomplete instead of returning fake global zero.

acceptance_cases.name: Cross-slot compatibility and match safety
acceptance_cases.scenario: Draining/incompatible/unreachable targets remain visible but unavailable; no cross-process pairing or live-match migration; ongoing match/auth-result continuity is unaffected.

acceptance_cases.name: Shared frontend and localization
acceptance_cases.scenario: Native Linux and web show consistent populated/search/page-two/empty/loading/error/stale/partial/invite/rematch/opt-out states; complete pt-BR/en keys, keyboard focus and no combat-blocking modal.

source_files.integration_note: Read from the separate P72 branch; not yet assumed merged into the audited base.

owner_screenshot.purpose: Entry point/style reference; visible zero counts do not by themselves prove a backend defect.

delivery.publication: Local commits and stop for review; current AGENTS.md forbids push. No VPS/deploy authorization.

history_acceptance_cases.name: Mode and frozen ownership
history_acceptance_cases.scenario: Account-bound completed Ranked/Casual/Challenge/rematch/private-room PvP creates the right participant entries; guests/Practice/spectators/unaccepted invites do not gain account history; late login cannot claim a different frozen seat.

history_acceptance_cases.name: Durable visibility choice
history_acceptance_cases.scenario: Existing and new accounts default private; owner changes to public/private via authenticated committed preference; reconnect/device changes preserve it; migrations/retry never reset a saved choice.

history_acceptance_cases.name: Private and public authorization
history_acceptance_cases.scenario: Owner sees own entries under either setting; another account cannot use a copied entry/cursor/account field to read them; public reads obey current visibility, including the legacy recent API and old ranking clients.

history_acceptance_cases.name: Exact MVP statistic semantics
history_acceptance_cases.scenario: Successful purchases/evolutions/fortifications and finalized choices count once, including dead champions, excluding rejected commands/summon generation; Stronghold terminal values and combat/wall time are frozen correctly.

history_acceptance_cases.name: Unavailable and legacy metrics
history_acceptance_cases.scenario: No total-damage claim from source-less Hit amounts; shield/overkill/friendly/periodic effects cannot become fabricated attribution; absent legacy fields are null/unavailable, and real measured zero stays distinct.

history_acceptance_cases.name: Result and reconnect consistency
history_acceptance_cases.scenario: MatchEnd/CompletedResult replay, Result UI and stored detail use the same authoritative personal summary and ResultId; retry does not increment metrics or replay celebration; Stored follows actual durable acknowledgment.

history_acceptance_cases.name: Atomic and idempotent persistence
history_acceptance_cases.scenario: Same canonical envelope replay inserts one parent and one side per participant, preserves random entry IDs and rolls back atomically on a failed side insert; conflicting duplicate quarantines rather than overwrites.

history_acceptance_cases.name: Crash boundaries and journal recovery
history_acceptance_cases.scenario: Exercise before journal, after journal, after DB commit/before journal removal and restart; assert exact stated recovery guarantees, bounded retry and explicit unrecoverable gaps, without altering outcome or Elo.

history_acceptance_cases.name: Storage backpressure and release drain
history_acceptance_cases.scenario: Disk full/read-only/corrupt envelope/queue cap/store outage never claims Saved or blocks a live tick; pending work is counted before slot retirement and retained/handoff to a compatible recovery owner is explicit.

history_acceptance_cases.name: Verified resumable backfill
history_acceptance_cases.scenario: Only canonical account-bound Ranked rows backfill in bounded checkpoints; newer writes and repeated batches do not duplicate results; old non-ranked log names are never used as ownership evidence.

history_acceptance_cases.name: Keyset paging correctness
history_acceptance_cases.scenario: More than 50 fixtures, same-end-time ties and a new head insertion preserve deterministic keyset traversal without duplicates; forged/oversize/wrong-subject/filter cursors fail safely; query plan uses the participant account/time/entry index.

history_acceptance_cases.name: Privacy projection and private opponents
history_acceptance_cases.scenario: Public opt-in exposes only that owner summary; private-room/Challenge/rematch/guest opponent identity and other-side private stats are redacted; internal source IDs, room codes, seeds and tokens never leak.

history_acceptance_cases.name: Concurrent privacy saves and caches
history_acceptance_cases.scenario: Commit a public-to-private revision then deny new public reads across list/detail/legacy recent; stale If-Match public save conflicts instead of overwriting; no shared cache/ETag/static-profile bypass or false retraction promise.

history_acceptance_cases.name: Authenticated slot routing
history_acceptance_cases.scenario: Owner HTTP goes to the correct Access index with current token and Origin policy; expired token uses coordinated refresh, not an expired match lease; malformed/duplicate headers and unintended CORS fail safely.

history_acceptance_cases.name: Migration and safe rollback
history_acceptance_cases.scenario: Additive migration preserves existing ranked/auth/store rows and settings; old public API slots cannot bypass privacy; rollback preserves guards/data/journals rather than dropping history or reviving unguarded recent.

history_acceptance_cases.name: Ranking and correction separation
history_acceptance_cases.scenario: History outcome stays canonical while rating may be pending; committed/zero/unranked states differ; approved correction updates the safe displayed effective delta without a second Elo settlement or exposure of integrity risk signals.

history_acceptance_cases.name: UI and read-only scope
history_acceptance_cases.scenario: Shared web/native owner/public list/detail, locale/time zone, loading/empty/error/pending/partial/private/unsupported/401/429 states and privacy save/revision behavior work; no replay/export/delete/old-history rematch action appears.

history_acceptance_cases.name: Bounds, versions and confidentiality
history_acceptance_cases.scenario: Enforce page/body/timeout/semaphore/journal bounds; unknown catalog/summary versions degrade safely; attacker IDs and store failure do not become empty success; no credential/payload logs or automatic purge.

history_extension.owner_decision: The player chooses public or private history; persist the choice on the account.
history_extension.persistence: Existing SQLite/store worker plus bounded terminal history envelopes, idempotent source keys, participant entries and per-slot recovery journals.
history_extension.private_opponents: Public projection redacts private-game and guest opponent identity and other-seat private data.
history_extension.legacy_recent: Existing public profile recent must respect the same visibility choice; it is not an exemption.
history_extension.mutation_concurrency: Conditional expected privacy revision (If-Match); stale save returns 409, no blind public overwrite.
history_extension.legacy_backfill: Only verified account-bound Ranked rows; partial/result-only quality; no guessed old non-ranked ownership.
proposed_wire: Bounded PersonalMatchSummary on per-seat MatchEnd/CompletedResult replay
Private MatchHistoryStatus { result_id, entry_id, state: Pending|Stored|Delayed }

read_bounds.paging: indexed keyset, account plus end time plus independent participant entry ID

journal_starting_bounds.note: Reuse existing ranked journal pattern limits for a separate history directory; do not share the rating finalizer.

history_extension.rollout: Privacy-aware handlers/proxy across public-serving slots before opt-in; collection/API/UI staged; preserve guards/data/settings/journals on rollback.
history_extension.retention: No automatic deletion/purge; owner policy required before implementing destructive retention.
history_extension.runtime_evidence: Not run; only disposable conceptual-schema checks may be recorded as planning validation.

planning_validation.conceptual_sql: Passed in-memory SQLite only: default privacy for existing/new accounts, 65-match keyset with timestamp ties, owner-bound query, public/private guard query, conditional privacy revision, constraints, atomic rollback and intended paging index.
planning_validation.limitation: Conceptual SQL validation is not application migration, API access-control, recovery or deployment verification.
